analysis.tempoNote: Approximately 70–72 BPM at a slow pulse, or 140–144 BPM at double time. Onset tracking favours about 70.8/143.6 BPM; the independent estimator returns about 140.3 BPM with weak confidence. Allow for expressive timing and review before grid-based editing.
analysis.keyNote: No reliable single global key. Whole-track profiles disagree among G major, E-flat major, C minor and A-flat major. Local STFT windows favour G/D major early, E-flat major later and A-flat major toward the end. This suggests possible modulation, but requires musical review; do not publish one confirmed key.
analysis.method: Automated waveform, rhythm and tonal analysis; BPM and key are estimates. No listening verification.
